title: Daiichi Unit 3 fuel removal cover
source: Whole independent Unit3 fuel-removal cover: written57mEW x22.8mNS steel-clad dome/portal-truss structure,53.5m crown,47.6m eaves,36m workfloor, western/eastern support frames and concrete bearing blocks. Underlying damaged reactor, its floors/interiors and whole plant remain separate/unfinished. All appearance imagery unused. Qualla-first25families/0conflicts; cleared1971DOE imagery predates this cover and is not applied. Original operator structural submission archived by NRA2013: written steel truss/dome, steel folded cladding,57x22.8x53.5m. Numerical eave47.60/crown53.50/workfloor36.0 and original bearing OP10.500/26.900 retained; gradeOP10 inferred from original crownOP63.50 minus53.50m abovegrade; ground tie explicitly approximate. Source native13corner Unit3 envelope is context only; cover centred on southern west-projecting corridor with8m registration/3degree heading uncertainty. Roof profile uses circular segment matching written width/eave/crown, not observed curvature; portal leg count/locations/sections, bracing/joints/end panels, hidden details/neutral metal finish estimated2m. Eastern bearing blocks at16.9m require host reactor3F support, omitted in standalone cover. Nominal2019-11-08 native context/2013design/2018operation continuity unverified,currenteligiblefalse. No report figure/plan/photo/map/satellite pixels used.
identityStatus: Explicit native Unit3 envelope registers independently dimensioned dome cover approximately; not exact cover native corner survey.
geometryLabel: Written57x22.8m cover horizontal envelope controls, NOT native ground footprint. Original13point reactor context preserved separately.
